items.observation: The `timeout` dartdoc says 'A `TimeoutException` is thrown'. Since 1.0 a timeout returns as `AdapterException.transport`, with TimeoutException in the `cause` field (CHANGELOG.md:144-148; the catch is at lines 79-89 of the first adapter in the location list). There is no timeout-specific test, only a SocketException test (test/adapters_test.dart:398-408).
items.proposed_fix: Fix the three dartdoc comments to say 'AdapterException.transport, cause TimeoutException'. Add a test per adapter with a MockClient that never completes and a short timeout.
items.closure_criteria: All three adapter dartdoc comments state that a timeout surfaces as AdapterException.transport with TimeoutException on cause. Each adapter has a test with a MockClient that never completes and a short timeout asserting that exception.

items.observation: Base URL trimming, client ownership and close, the POST + transport funnel, the 2xx check, JSON decoding + shape validation and the `on TypeError` wrapper are repeated almost line by line across the three adapters. One fix has to be made in three places. As a result the complete methods run 110-130 lines.
items.proposed_fix: An unexported shared helper under lib/src/adapters/ (JSON POST + transport funnel + shape guard). Keep only request body construction and response reading in the adapter. Safety net: adapters_test.dart and gemini_adapter_test.dart.
items.closure_criteria: A single unexported helper under lib/src/adapters/ performs the JSON POST, the transport funnel and the shape guard. The three adapters keep only request building and response reading and adapters_test.dart plus gemini_adapter_test.dart pass.

items.observation: `catch (e)` also turns programming errors (Error) into AdapterException.transport. The documented types (SocketException, TimeoutException, http.ClientException) are already Exceptions. This violates the shared typed catch principle (J10).
items.proposed_fix: Use `on Exception catch (e)`. Add a test showing that an Error thrown by a custom client propagates. Record it in the CHANGELOG.
items.closure_criteria: All three transport catch sites read on Exception catch. A test shows an Error thrown by a custom client propagates unwrapped and the CHANGELOG records the change.

items.observation: A heuristic scan finds about 33 public declarations without `///` in front. The most critical is `LlmAdapter.complete`, the single extension point (adapter.dart:86). The same scan returns 0 in the other five packages.
items.proposed_fix: Write the missing dartdoc comments. Lock against regression by adding the `public_member_api_docs` lint to analysis_options.yaml.
items.closure_criteria: Every public declaration listed in the item carries a /// comment, including LlmAdapter.complete. The public_member_api_docs lint is enabled in analysis_options.yaml and reports no findings.

items.observation: The `dart create` template is still in place with its commented sections. The strict-casts/strict-inference/strict-raw-types settings from the sibling packages are off here.
items.proposed_fix: Simplify the template, turn on the strict modes, and close the resulting findings in the same change (finding count was not measured).
items.closure_criteria: analysis_options.yaml enables strict-casts, strict-inference and strict-raw-types with the template comments removed. Running dart analyze with those settings produces no findings.

items.observation: The dartdoc says integer normalization gives the same result on VM and web. CI runs tests only on the VM.
items.proposed_fix: Add `dart test -p chrome --exclude-tags e2e` to ci.yaml. Separate the tests that use dart:io (adapters_test.dart:2, 400; ollama_e2e_test.dart) with `@TestOn('vm')`.
items.closure_criteria: ci.yaml runs dart test -p chrome --exclude-tags e2e and the run passes. The test files that use dart:io carry @TestOn('vm').

items.observation: System messages are joined with two newlines in one adapter and a single newline in the other. A request containing only a system message throws ArgumentError in one adapter and goes to the API with empty `contents` in the other.
items.proposed_fix: Pick one separator and one empty-conversation policy, and add tests to both adapters. If the difference is intentional, write the rationale in the dartdoc.
items.closure_criteria: Both adapters named in the location use one system-message separator and one empty-conversation policy. Tests in both adapter test files pin the choice or the dartdoc explains the intentional difference.

items.observation: The deprecated unnamed `LlmResponse` constructor will be removed in 2.0.0. Until then extractRaw has to extract responses that carry both fields at once.
items.proposed_fix: Remove the constructor in 2.0.0, turn LlmResponse into a three-case closed type, and delete the instructor.dart:122-127 branch.
items.closure_criteria: Version 2.0.0 removes the deprecated unnamed LlmResponse constructor and ships LlmResponse as a three-case closed type. The branch at instructor.dart:122-127 is gone and the package tests pass.
